Azienda leader nel mondo della prima infanzia (toys, accessori tessile e fashion) riconosciuta per il forte impegno su sicurezza, qualità, sostenibilità e design innovativo. In un’ottica di potenziamento della funzione MARKETING, ricerca un/a MARKETING MANAGER che riporterà all’Amministratore Delegato. La figura dovrà guidare la strategia di marketing rafforzando il posizionamento premium del brand, aumentando la brand awareness e generando domanda sui canali e-commerce, retail e wholesale. Il ruolo presidia la crescita commerciale attraverso campagne integrate, gestione del budget, analisi dei dati e coordinamento del team marketing e dei partner esterni. Strategia & Brand ·       Definire e implementare la strategia di marketing in coerenza con gli obiettivi aziendali. ·       Supervisionare la brand identity e garantire coerenza su tutti i touchpoint (online, retail, packaging, ADV). ·       Sviluppare piani editoriali e campagne che valorizzino i valori del brand: sostenibilità, qualità, design. Campagne & Comunicazione ·       Pianificare e coordinare campagne multicanale (digital, social, influencer marketing, PR,eventi, advertising). ·       Gestire la produzione di contenuti (foto, video, storytelling) per e-commerce, social, newsletter e materiali retail. ·       Gestire partnership con influencer, ambassador e media. Digital Marketing & Performance ·       Collaborare con l’e-commerce manager per migliorare conversion rate, funnel e customer journey. ·       Coordinare attività relative al CRM. Analisi & Insight ·       Analizzare mercato, competitor e trend per identificare opportunità di crescita e innovazione. ·       Preparare report mensili per il management con insight, performance e raccomandazioni strategiche. Collaborazione cross-funzionale ·       Lavorare con il team sales per supportare lead generation, materiali commerciali e iniziative retail. ·       Collaborare con il team prodotto per lanciare nuove collezioni, campagne stagionali e promozioni. ·       Supportare l’area wholesale con materiali, presentazioni e strumenti di sell-in. Budget & Governance ·       Gestire il budget marketing, monitorando ROI e performance delle attività. ·       Coordinare agenzie esterne, fornitori e partner. ·       Gestire e sviluppare il team marketing, promuovendo cultura data-driven e creatività. Competenze richieste Hard skills · Esperienza di 5–8 anni in ruoli marketing in aziende consumer, fashion, baby care o lifestyle . ·       Ottima conoscenza di digital marketing, performance, social media e influencer marketing. ·       Capacità di gestione budget e lettura KPI. ·       Esperienzanella produzione di contenuti e nella gestione di agenzie creative. ·       Familiaritàcon e-commerce, CRM e strumenti di analytics, forte mentalità digitale efamiliarità con strumenti di AI applicata al marketing Soft skills ·       Leadership collaborativa e capacità di gestire team e fornitori. ·       Visione strategica unita a forte operatività adatta ad un contesto in forte crescita ma ancora poco strutturato. ·       Creatività, sensibilità estetica e attenzione al dettaglio. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Atlante Laura Corsi Laura Corsi HR Business Partner | Talent Acquisition | International HR | People & Culture | Talent Management Brief description of the role: Marketing in Atlante Italy is first and foremost a commercial lever to increase revenues. You own the country execution of marketing activities in coordination with the central Marketing, Communication, CRM, App and Graphic teams at HQ, ensuring full alignment with Group priorities while adapting execution to the Italian market. You operate within Atlante’s matrix organization, with hierarchical reporting to the CEO Italy and functional reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer at HQ. B2C, digital, CRM, lifecycle marketing, brand and communication activities are defined and coordinated by the Group Marketing function at HQ, while country execution, local commercial activations, partnerships and customer experience initiatives are owned by the Italian Marketing function. You manage the local marketing budget and act as the country interface towards HQ Marketing, while partnering closely with Commercial, Operations, Infrastructure, Public Affairs and Finance to maximize commercial performance and customer satisfaction. Value creation: You create value by translating Atlante Italy’s commercial priorities into integrated marketing initiatives that increase customer acquisition, charging session frequency, customer retention and customer lifetime value. By combining B2C marketing, CRM-driven lifecycle programs, trade marketing, commercial partnerships and brand communication, you maximize the return on Atlante Italy’s marketing investments, strengthen the network’s commercial appeal and ensure a best-in-class customer experience across every customer touchpoint. You ensure that marketing contributes directly to commercial performance, while acting as the country interface to Group Marketing capabilities — including brand, communication, CRM and research — and guaranteeing full consistency with the Group marketing framework defined by the Chief Marketing Officer. Core Responsibilities: B2C, Digital, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Own the country execution of B2C, digital, CRM and lifecycle marketing activities in coordination with HQ Marketing. Drive customer acquisition, charging session frequency, retention and customer lifetime value through integrated B2C marketing initiatives. Contribute to the execution of local digital marketing campaigns — including paid social, SEM, display, programmatic and app marketing — ensuring commercial effectiveness and alignment with HQ. Animate influencer marketing activities, including identifying influencers, developing relationships during the weeks leading up to local campaign launches, following up and validating content and videosOversee CRM and lifecycle marketing programs — including email, push notifications, in-app communications and SMS — across the full customer journey. Drive local Atlante app performance, including registrations, app engagement, ASO, in-app communications and push notification strategy. Coordinate local campaign briefs, marketing assets and country execution together with the HQ Marketing, Communication and Graphic teams. Monitor and optimize country marketing KPIs, including CAC, LTV, retention, charging sessions per user, app engagement, NPS and commercial contribution. Own the marketing budget relating to local activities, including planning, allocation, monthly tracking and optimization of marketing efficiency and ROI. Oversee the local digital ecosystem, including the website, app communications, social media, SEM and app store presence. Coordinate the local implementation of loyalty initiatives and customer engagement programs. Establish a structured customer insights feedback loop towards HQ, leveraging campaign performance, app data, customer feedback, NPS and market trends. Trade Marketing, Commercial Activations & Partnerships Support the country’s commercial activation calendar, contributing to customer acquisition, station utilization and commercial revenues. Oversee commercial activations at Atlante stations, including openings, promotional initiatives, roadshows and customer engagement events. Drive co-loyalty agreements and commercial partnerships with national and local consumer brands aligned with the EV customer journey. Coordinate landlord co-marketing initiatives together with the Site Acquisition and Partnership teams. Establish and personally maintain direct agreements with services and operators in proximity of Atlante stations (shopping centres, retail, bars, restaurants, hospitality, leisure) to enrich the customer experience during charging time. Support the B2B & Partnership Manager Italia, working four hands, through marketing initiatives, pricing campaigns, promotional mechanics and sales enablement activities. Marketing Governance & Team Leadership Manage the local marketing budget and optimize resource allocation to maximize commercial impact. Monitor marketing performance through business and marketing KPIs, ensuring the continuous improvement of efficiency and return on investment. Act as the primary interface between Atlante Italy and the HQ Marketing, Communication, CRM, App and Graphic teams. Coordinate agencies, suppliers and marketing partners, ensuring quality, efficiency and budget discipline. Brand, Communication & Reputation Own the country execution of Atlante Italy’s communication plan in alignment with Group Brand guidelines. Manage press and media relations. Strengthen Atlante’s brand awareness and reputation across the Italian market. Supervise editorial planning, website content and local communication materials. Requirements Master's degree in Marketing, Economics, Business Administration, Communication or a related field. 7–10 years of experience in marketing roles, with at least 3 years in a managerial position with country-level responsibility. Proven track record in B2C marketing with a strong commercial orientation and a direct impact on revenues, customer acquisition and retention. Solid hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid social, SEM, display, programmatic and app marketing. Strong expertise in CRM and lifecycle marketing, including email, push notifications, in-app communications and SMS, managed across the full customer journey. Experience in app marketing and performance, including registrations, engagement, ASO and in-app communication strategies. Experience in trade marketing, commercial activations and events, such as openings, roadshows and promotional initiatives. Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial partnerships, co-marketing and co-loyalty agreements with national and local brands, retail and hospitality operators. Experience in influencer marketing, from scouting to content validation. Experience in press and media relations and in executing brand and communication plans. Strong experience in managing a marketing budget, including planning, allocation, monthly tracking and ROI optimization. Analytical, data-driven mindset, with confident use of marketing KPIs such as CAC, LTV, retention, NPS and engagement metrics. Experience working in international, matrix organizations, coordinating with HQ functions while adapting execution to the local market. Proven experience in managing agencies (media, creative, PR, events) and marketing suppliers. Native or fluent Italian and fluent English, both written and spoken. Soft skills: Strong commercial orientation and results focus. Excellent stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority, which matters in a matrix organization. Hands-on attitude, able to move between strategy and operational execution. Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Autonomy, proactivity and strong organizational skills. • Reports to: -Hyerarchically: CEO Italy -Functionally: Chief Marketing Officer, Atlante HQ • Gross Annual Salary: starting € 45.000 - according to experience - plus MBO, benefits, welfare, • Location: Milan office - hybrid remote Show more Show less Livello di anzianità Livello medio Tipo di impiego A tempo pieno Settori Servizi infrastrutturali Le referenze raddoppiano le tue probabilità di ottenere un colloquio presso Atlante Guarda chi conosci Ricevi una notifica quando viene pubblicata una nuova offerta di lavoro. title: Marketing Manager
motivazione: L'annuncio è estremamente scarno ('Marketing Manager Azienda non specificata') e non offre dettagli su budget, canali o requisiti specifici. La tua esperienza nella definizione di strategie di marketing integrate e gestione di budget si allinea al titolo, ma l'assenza di informazioni rende impossibile valutare i requisiti chiave o eventuali gap.

title: Head of Digital Sales
motivazione: Chiedono 7-10 anni di esperienza in ambito Digital e la gestione di stakeholder, requisiti che soddisfi pienamente con il tuo percorso. Il gap principale riguarda l'esperienza specifica nell'offerta ADV digitale (display, programmatic, video) tipica di una concessionaria pubblicitaria, sebbene la tua forte competenza in strategie digitali e go-to-market riduca notevolmente la distanza.
